name: unifik-monorepo
description: Unifik - Ecossistema Acadêmico, Rede Social, Gestão de Eventos e Certificação

scripts.build:backend: npm --workspace=packages/types run build && npm --workspace=apps/backend run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=packages/types run build && npm --workspace=apps/web-admin run build
scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (process.env.RENDER) { execSync('npm run build:backend', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npm run build:backend && npm run build:web', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
